integrity: The theorem, assumptions, proof, and verification script are provided in full. The finite checker is supporting evidence, not a substitute for the arbitrary-size analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The disease-free opinion equilibria have local exponential attraction; global convergence or uniqueness for the discontinuous signed-opinion flow is not asserted.
The exact count requires a star graph, w at least m+3 and the explicit positive subcritical epidemic parameters; it does not extend automatically to arbitrary signed networks.
Historical originality has received bounded literature comparison, not independent exhaustive priority or scientific validation.
title: Exponential coexistence of stable disease-free opinion profiles on epidemic–opinion stars
